instruction: How to add a tc filter that matches on ip src and dst
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 match ip dst 192.168.1.100 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a tc filter using basic match
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: basic match 'ipset(whitelist src)' action drop

instruction: How to add a u32 filter that matches on ip option
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u8 0x44 0xff at 0 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter that matches on IP total length
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u16 0x0046 0xffff at 2 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter that matches on IP id
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u16 0x1234 0xffff at 4 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for IP flags
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u16 0x4000 0x6000 at 6 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter to match TCP option
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 at tcp-header offset 0 match u8 0x02 0xff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with nexthdr offset
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff match u8 8 at nexthdr+0 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a flower filter with ct_state
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower ct_state +trk action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter with ct_mark
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower ct_mark 1 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter with ct_zone
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower ct_zone 1 action drop

instruction: How to set up tc-vlan pop/push with nat
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol 802.1Q flower vlan_id 100 action vlan pop action nat action mirred egress redirect dev eth1

instruction: How to add a flower filter for IPv6 destination
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ipv6 flower dst_ip 2001:db8::1 action drop

instruction: How to add flower filter for IPv6 flow label
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ipv6 flower ip6_flow_label 100 action drop

instruction: How to add flower filter for TCP source port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower ip_proto tcp src_port 443 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter for ICMP type and code
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower ip_proto icmp icmp_type 8 icmp_code 0 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter with enc key for tunnels
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower enc_src_ip 10.0.0.1 enc_key_id 100 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter to match on enc_dst_ip
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower enc_dst_ip 192.168.2.2 enc_dst_port 4789 action drop

instruction: How to add a skip_sw flower filter for HW offload
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower skip_sw src_ip 10.0.0.1 action drop

instruction: How to add a skip_hw flower filter for SW only
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower skip_hw src_ip 10.0.0.1 action drop

instruction: How to add a shared block filter
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress_block 1 clsact && tc filter add block 1 protocol ip flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 action drop

instruction: How to add a flower filter with a cookie
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower src_ip 10.0.0.1 cookie 0x12345678 action drop

instruction: How to show tc filter with cookie
output: tc -s filter show dev eth0 parent 1: | grep cookie

instruction: How to add a tc filter that sets a tunnel key
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower dst_ip 10.0.0.0/24 action tunnel_key set id 100 dst_ip 10.0.0.2 action mirred egress redirect dev vxlan0

instruction: How to add a tunnel_key unset action in tc
output: tc filter add dev vxlan0 parent 1: protocol ip flower enc_dst_ip 10.0.0.2 action tunnel_key unset action mirred egress redirect dev eth0
